finding: DT-006 launch identity prerequisite for verified descendants
classification: Native/client launch-identity primitive implemented and locally verified; full descendant tracking remains open.
behavior: Native launch returns a fresh UUIDv4 with its PID. The live registry is keyed by UUID and verifies the expected PID.
An older waiter removes only its launch entry; missing, mismatched or retired identities cannot adopt another launch.
Every client status query carries the native identity through its playtime watcher. PID-only and malformed queries are refused.
An old native reply without identity still represents a successful local launch but starts no unverifiable server session or watcher.
No child is killed by watcher retirement; direct-child waiting/reaping is retained and completed entries are removed.

Both PID and ID must match; a tracked PID without its ID is refused.
An actual old child waiter finishes after a controlled same-PID replacement entry; the replacement ID remains live. This models identity substitution, not actual kernel PID recycling.
Existing direct-child and exit regressions remain in the full native suite.
